subtitle: Lesson 101 · Database Design Fundamentals

caption: Not attached to any table or column — a SEQUENCE is its own database object.

code:
SELECT NEXT VALUE FOR dbo.LessonSeq AS NextID;
-- 1, then 2, then 3 ...
caption: Each call hands out the next number, which is never reused by this sequence.
Both tables draw from the SAME sequence — something IDENTITY can never do.

code:
DECLARE @NewOrderID INT = NEXT VALUE FOR dbo.LessonSeq;

INSERT INTO dbo.LessonOrders (OrderID) VALUES (@NewOrderID);
caption: IDENTITY makes you insert first, then read back. SEQUENCE lets you get the number up front.

subtitle: Filling in a value automatically when a column is left out.
